description: Search flights between two airports or cities. Returns offers with the price in grosze, schedule, fare family and a link to the offer page. Use suggest_places first when you only know a city name.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child in years, in the same order as children.

fromCity.description: Departure city name. Defaults to the IATA code.

fromCode.description: IATA code of the departure airport or city, for example WAW.

infants.description: Number of infants under 2 travelling on an adult's lap.

limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return, from 1 to 30. Default 10.

returnDate.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for a one-way flight.

toCity.description: Arrival city name. Defaults to the IATA code.

toCode.description: IATA code of the arrival airport or city, for example BCN.

name: search_flights
title: Search flights
